title: Every difference from the mock in an audit names the card or task that settles it
goal: Runners keep finishing work that differs from the user's mocks and writing the difference into the audit as a note, when the rules say a difference is either fixed, filed, or put to the user on a card. Two days running the user's mocks were quietly undercut this way. Finishing a task should not be possible while an audit lists a difference from the mock that nobody has been asked about.
notes: From the 2026-10-03 digest design review. Rule already written: queue/bin/runner-prompt.md line ~352 (differences in layout, colour, control type, spacing or copy length are defects to fix in this task or to file as p1, not notes) and objectives principle 4 (a departure is a decision card). Evidence: 2026-10-02 audio effects drew Effects as a section where the mock draws a dock group (logged on the-panel-keeps-its-promise-on-a-video-document); 2026-10-03 timing strip marks lists mock differences (glyph ends, two-line wrap, bright headings) as rough with no card (filed as layer-names-on-the-timing-strip-read-whole-besid); 2026-10-02 sound EQ and pivot audits list differences with reasons but no card. The done gate already has one refusal of this kind (off-by-default switches, queue.mjs off-by-default), so this sits beside it.
acceptance: Marking an app task done is refused when its audit lists a difference from a mock that names neither an open or answered decision card, nor a task id, nor an earlier task that settled it
The refusal says which audit line and what to add, in one plain sentence
The audits from 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03 (audio effects, EQ and compressor, pivot somewhere else, timing strip marks) are run through the check and what it says about each is in this task log
A drill shows a done refused and then accepted once the line names a card

log.note: Built: queue/bin/mock-differences.mjs reads an audit's rough lines a sentence at a time and picks out differences from a mock (mentions a mock or a mock page, and is not 'no mock covers this', an addition the mock does not draw, 'goes further than the mock', a pure match, or a long mock line moved behind the question mark). A difference is settled when the line names a live decision card id, another task id, the user's dated answer ('your call on <date>'), a written rule ('UX-PATTERNS §7'), or (only on a task the user filed) 'because you asked'. queue-lib mockCheck runs on queue.mjs status <id> done for app tasks, on the audits written since the task was claimed plus any named in the closing note (not ones quoted in notes as evidence). New: queue.mjs mock-check <id | audit.json...>. Drill: queue/bin/mock-diff-drill.mjs (34 checks, run by MockDifferenceGateTests in Scripts/test.sh). Runner prompt's side-by-side rule now says the gate exists.

The four audits through the check (node queue/bin/queue.mjs mock-check <audit>): 2026-10-02-audio-effects.json: 4 differences, all naming nothing (line 1 Audio Effects title vs the mock's Effects; line 2 a panel section where the mock draws a dock group with a rail tab; line 4 cross and no on/off dot vs the mock's grip and dot; line 5 menu rows without the mock's icons). Lines 3, 6 and 7 not read as differences (no mock word; 'go further than the mock'; the lock note). 2026-10-02-sound-eq-compressor.json: 2 differences; line 1 (no grip because the order is fixed) names nothing; line 2 (eye instead of the mock's dot) is settled by the user's answer on 2026-09-08. 2026-10-02-pivot-somewhere-else.json: 2 differences, both naming nothing (line 1 no pivot tool on Y, 'an earlier task left it out' with no id; line 2 Around box without border and numbers, 'decided in an earlier task' with no id); line 3 (Custom row the mock does not draw) is an addition. 2026-10-03-timing-strip-marks.json: 2 differences naming nothing (line 1 circles vs the mock's squares at the path glyph's ends; line 3 one-line names and dim headings vs the mock's wrap and bright headings); line 4 (kinds the mock does not draw) is an addition. So 9 of 10 differences would have refused done; each of those four tasks would have been held.

Calibration: over every audit since 2026-09-25 (162 rough lines mentioning a mock) the check reads 104 unsettled differences, 11 settled and 47 not differences. Known misses: a departure in a sentence that says 'its' instead of 'the mock' (2026-10-01 timing names tooltip), and one hidden behind 'the mock has no X' (captions Text section). Known false reads: 'the existing video.html layout unchanged' and a contrast note about the mock's glass tone. Both cost a runner one id or a reword, never the mock. Left rough, not filed: the 102-odd unsettled lines in older audits are history; the gate is forward-only and nothing re-opens those tasks.

queue.mjs status <id> done now refuses an app task while an audit it wrote lists a difference from a mock naming no card, task, dated user answer or UX-PATTERNS rule; the refusal names the audit line and says what to add. New queue.mjs mock-check <id|audit>. Verified: mock-diff-drill.mjs 34/34 (refused, then accepted once the line names a card), reach/decision/cli drills green, Scripts/test.sh 11137 tests pass. Four named audits run through it: 9 of 10 differences named nothing (details in log). Commit ccb6fc6b.
